items.title: Fail build:check when any tracked HTML page references an internal file that does not exist
items.why: Both defects shipped past 545 build:check steps: crawl-all-pages checks only route status, audit-site-links only anchors to project slugs, and check-base-href-resolution only pages carrying a <base>. No gate resolves every internal href/src.
items.userOutcome: Info-finding and conversion: visitors and agents stop meeting dead internal links and broken images, because the next one fails the build instead of reaching production.
items.acceptance: scripts/check-local-references.mjs --self-test passes; live run passes on the fixed tree and fails on the pre-fix tree; registered in build:check:steps; full build:check green.

premises.claim: Base-href checker is scoped to pages that declare a base
premises.pattern: for each HTML file carrying a <base href>

items.recipe: Walk tracked HTML (git ls-files), strip script/template/style bodies, resolve root-absolute and relative href/src (honoring <base>) against tracked files, directory index.html and Pages _redirects sources; report and exit 1. Self-test with fixtures. Register one build:check step.

L2.recipe: Deterministic gate with self-test registered in build:check.

L3.recipe: Also resolve srcset, CSS url() and JSON feeds; not selected.

items.stageRationale: Prevents recurrence of proven broken-journey regressions without changing public policy.

executionLog.evidence: Self-test 18/18; live 334 pages / 28,929 refs pass; pre-fix tree fails naming exactly /assets/logo.png (8 pages) and /news/personas/. Independent review: fix (script src unchecked) applied, plus template contents and exact-case matching; 1.8s runtime. Registered once in build:check:steps.

items.title: Restore the investor-portal brand mark (8 pages reference a non-existent assets/logo.png)
items.why: Every investor-portal page, including the public login and investor-interest form, requests ../assets/logo.png, which does not exist; production answers 404 and the brand block renders a broken image (alt text on login/apply).
items.userOutcome: Conversion: a prospective investor opening the interest form or login sees the VaultSpark mark rather than a broken image, protecting trust at the point of submission (CANON-006 branding).
items.acceptance: No investor-portal page references assets/logo.png; replacements resolve to existing assets; gate passes; production pages serve the new src after deploy.
